name: Websol Energy System Ltd
title: Websol Energy System Ltd - 517498 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 1,049 cr and PAT INR 303 cr on cell line doubling, but cell prices softening (13–13.5 c/W) and capex for Phase 2 and Andhra expansion remain undated and unfunded.

utilisation.quote: our combined cell capacity utilization stood at 90%

capex.quote: we are evaluating what is best for the company, the right sequencing, the right funding structure and the right execution approach

triggers.label: Cell realisation softening to 13–13.5 c/W
triggers.quote: So, there has been some softening in the price.

triggers.label: Andhra expansion timing undefined
triggers.quote: On Andhra Pradesh, we are evaluating the next steps and we will share more details in time to come.

triggers.label: Receivables and inventory rising
triggers.quote: we’ve seen some increase in debtors and inventory

triggers.label: Cell utilisation above 90%
triggers.quote: our combined cell capacity utilization stood at 90%

triggers.label: Andhra target June 2027 reaffirmed
triggers.quote: I think June 2027 is what we are targeting.

guidance.quote: by February 2027, which is less than one year from today, we will be able to upgrade the line and start commercial production
I think June 2027 is what we are targeting.

guidance.metric: Cell and module ALMM-III wafer/ingot readiness
guidance.quote: the target is to commission ahead of the ALMM List 3 deadline of June 2028

red_flags.label: Receivables and inventory rising
red_flags.quote: the increase in the working capital is largely driven by the inventory and the receivables

red_flags.label: Management evasive on Andhra and Phase 2 timing
red_flags.quote: we will share more details in time to come

red_flags.label: Mid-quarter capacity shift: 15-day revenue loss and TOPCon ramp risk
red_flags.quote: we are estimating that a revenue loss will be around for 15 days

evasions.topic: Phase 2 / Andhra capex timing and funding
evasions.quote: we will share more details in time to come
We do not report the margins separately.
we are still on the evaluation phase
